summary: Built scripts/onboard-mine-assets.js (4 signal classes: per-class inventory+naming/dir conventions; size outliers >5x class median with sips image dims, silent skip if sips fails; git churn — frequently-replaced assets + rationale-bearing commit messages; asset→code reference map + capped orphan lists). Emits asset-notes.json in the shared miner schema (kind:'asset'). Wired into onboard.js miner stage (now 4 miners) and onboard-learn.js gatherCandidates (one-line registration, same pattern config used — the filename list there is hardcoded, schema itself unchanged). Verified: game-repo fixture → 14 candidates across all classes, sips degrades gracefully on fake pngs; self-repo → 2 valid candidates, no crash; schema-validated against gatherCandidates' exact field usage; node --check clean. Merged to main fast-forward @2409af5. Key finding for /13: on the game-shaped fixture, git/doc miners emitted 0 candidates vs assets' 14 — asset signals dominate where prose/history is thin. Also found+flagged (separate chip): onboard-mine-git.js readLog split(FLD_SEP) bug makes its touched-files list always empty.
